notes.title: Good news, important update
notes.content:
Yes, we now support Live2D in the Workshop.
Currently the system cannot automatically identify what content is being loaded, so when loading VTuber models from the Workshop, be careful not to select the wrong one.
At present only one model can appear at a time.
If the model doesn't appear in full screen, you can press Ctrl+C to make it full screen.
Now the Workshop can display titles, which makes selecting files much easier.

I will continue working hard on updates. I pulled another all-nighter and need to go to sleep now. So tired.

notes.title: Important update
notes.content:
Changed the rendering method. Now it's more advanced, correspondingly all workshop content needs to be updated, fortunately there isn't much.
Added a new cyber mode, perfect for parties.
